name: Ananya Bora
body: Walked in at 6pm with a shattered screen, walked out at 7:15 with the phone looking new. They showed me the old and new panel side by side before fitting it — no other shop in town has done that for me.

name: Rohit Deka
body: Battery was dying by 2pm every day. Forty minutes and ₹4,500 later it lasts a full day again. They printed a health report and stapled it to the bill.

name: Priyanka Saikia
body: Dropped my Pixel in a bucket during Bihu cleaning. Two other shops said it was gone. Mickey Mobile cleaned the board and had it back to me in a day and a half with all my photos intact.

name: Imran Hussain
body: Bought a refurbished 13 for my sister. Battery health showed 94%, came with a case and protector already fitted, and they set it up from her old phone at the counter. Six months in, zero issues.

name: Nilakshi Gogoi
body: Genuine stock and about two thousand under the online price. Only reason it is not five stars is that I waited twenty minutes at the counter on a Saturday — go on a weekday.

name: Debojit Kalita
body: Had to wiggle the cable to charge for months. They diagnosed it free, quoted ₹2,700 upfront, and it did not go a rupee over. Fast charging is back to 100W.

name: Meghna Choudhury
body: A foldable screen is not a cheap fix anywhere, but they were the only place in Tinsukia that would touch it, and they were upfront about the cost before opening it up.

name: Sanjay Tamuli
body: Laser removal, colour matched perfectly, wireless charging still works. They also cleaned the charging port for free while it was open.
